response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(patient_avg_pt) as avg_pt, AVG(patient_avg_alp_gpt_ratio) as avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) as patient_avg_pt, AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 THEN l.ALP * 1.0 / l.GPT ELSE NULL END) as patient_avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT l2.ID FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND l2.`U-PRO` != '-') GROUP BY l.ID) patient_averages JOIN Patient p ON patient_averages.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX ORDER BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero prevention: when GPT is 0 or NULL, the ALP/GPT ratio is treated as missing for that record and excluded from the patient's average.
The condition 'recorded and is something other than '-' means U-PRO IS NOT NULL AND U-PRO != '-'.
